official_sdk_build_tools_36.source: Google Android SDK repository2-3.xml: build-tools;36.0.0 linux
official_sdk_build_tools_36.integration: Python Eye IDE installs Google package data only after explicit consent and checksum verification, overlays individually tested Bionic aapt2/aidl/zipalign from SHA-256 pinned native candidates, runs executable probes, preserves source.properties revision, requires real APK build before Ready.
safety: Never reuse x86_64 or Linux glibc ARM64 executables
Never modify official package revision metadata
Check downloaded archive SHA-1 and size
Separate CLI readiness from APK build proof

python_runtime_matrix.selection: Build-time per APK, not six resident runtimes
